Character.Traits: Swordmaster of the Ginaz, Loyal to House Vereth, Scarred Veteran
Character.Ambition: Justice: see the Harkonnen assassin answer for my brother's death.

Statements.Duty statement: My blade belongs to House Vereth.
Statements.Justice statement: No murder of my blood goes unanswered.
Statements.Truth statement: A lie in the dueling ring is a death sentence.

Notes.Relationships: Trains the heir, Lady Ysane; distrusts the Mentat.
Notes.History: Twelve years at the Ginaz school; returned to find his brother poisoned.
